author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: LattePanda has expanded its x86 compute module lineup with the Mu Ultra, a compact device based on Intel Core Ultra 200V “Lunar Lake” processors. The module is offered with Core Ultra 5 226V and Core Ultra 7 256V options, up to 115 TOPS of combined INT8 AI performance, 16GB of LPDDR5X memory, PCIe 4.0 expansion, […]
title: x86 compute module features Intel Core Ultra 200V with up to 115 TOPS
